requirements.completionPolicy: this foundation does not mark PRE-04, PM-03, PM-11 or full SOL-01 complete

owner.apiModulePolicy: do not create or extend a public module API until WorkBinding or a business Context provides a real caller
owner.businessBoundary: PLATFORM owns reusable template revisions and manual form-instance values; consuming Contexts own their business state, validation, approval, completion and history

approvedApproach.firstVersionPolicy: retain every control and configuration surface currently exposed by the repository FormCreate designer, including iframe, API selector, linkage, events, functions and parse functions
approvedApproach.futureRestrictionPolicy: a later restriction requires a new forward specification and new template revision; published revisions and existing instances are never rewritten

auditedImplementation.auditWorktreeDifference: governance-only changes; every audited product source remains identical to productCodeCommit

legacy requirement-analysis classes, APIs, routes, pages, data and behavior

treat legacy tables as PLATFORM truth

templateAvailability.semantics: availability controls only new manual selection and instance creation

templateRevision.immutability: PUBLISHED configuration, rules, engine versions and publication facts have no update or delete command

manualInstance.semantics: the foundation instance is a mutable CAS-protected value carrier with no submit, complete, approve, delete or template-switch transition

rules: current_published_revision_id is null until a revision is published
current_published_revision_id always belongs to this template
ENABLED manual selection requires a non-null current published revision
metadata PATCH never mutates a revision
draft_marker=1 only for DRAFT and null for PUBLISHED
PUBLISHED rows are immutable and non-deletable
form_conf_json is a JSON object and form_rules_json is a JSON array
every fillable field key is non-empty and unique within the revision
user REST creates only owner_context=PLATFORM and object_type=MANUAL_DYNAMIC_FORM with object_id equal to the preallocated instance id
template revision identity and engine versions never change after creation
value_json contains ordinary field values only; PmsFileArtifact facts are projected from F-PLT-001
false, zero, null, empty string and empty array retain distinct JSON semantics
ordinary value PATCH uses version CAS

publishValidation: configuration parses as a JSON object
rules parse as a JSON array
fillable field keys are non-empty and unique
engine code and pinned versions are supported by the current application

fieldDiscovery.walk: recursively traverse every rule object and its children arrays in stable document order
fieldDiscovery.valueField: a rule whose field property is a non-blank string
fieldDiscovery.uniqueness: value field keys are unique across the complete revision, including nested layouts
fieldDiscovery.fileField: type=PmsFileArtifact classifies a controlled file field; other rule types remain ordinary values
fieldDiscovery.unknownComponent: retain the complete rule unchanged; the server does not delete an unknown component merely because it is not a controlled file field

notAppliedInVersion1: API URL or endpoint catalog allowlist
event, function or parseFunc static analysis

executionBoundary.apiSelector: configured GET or POST is issued by the existing frontend request client; PLATFORM provides no server proxy
executionBoundary.iframe: the configured URL is loaded by the browser and remains subject to real CSP, CORS, frame and target-site policy
executionBoundary.functions: published administrator-authored event/function/parseFunc strings are evaluated by the existing FormCreate runtime
executionBoundary.serverAuthorization: every target API still enforces its own tenant, function and data-scope authorization
executionBoundary.businessResult: script, API or iframe success is never a domain command success fact

manualSelection.eligible: template availability is ENABLED and the requested revision is the template current PUBLISHED revision
manualSelection.conflictPolicy: disablement or current revision change between selection and creation returns VERSION_CONFLICT and never substitutes another revision

instanceValueContract.ordinaryPatch: partial object; only present ordinary fields change
instanceValueContract.fileFieldInput: reject PmsFileArtifact keys in ordinary PATCH
instanceValueContract.render: always use the instance frozen revision and engine versions
instanceValueContract.allowedActions: server derives from trusted tenant, function permissions, instance creator and current versions

fileOwnerKey.referenceKey: stable slotKey UUID retained for one user intent

pmsFileArtifactField.fieldKeyPolicy: the frozen revision must contain the exact fieldKey and componentName; fieldKey is non-empty, unique and cannot contain '/'
pmsFileArtifactField.storagePolicy: instance value_json stores no forged file vector, storage key or permanent URL
pmsFileArtifactField.ordinaryUploadPolicy: ordinary FormCreate upload controls remain available and their URL/JSON values are ordinary values, never controlled FileArtifact evidence
pmsFileArtifactField.readPolicy: one instance detail submits every frozen PmsFileArtifact field purpose as one FileArtifactApi.inspectReferenceSets batch and maps the returned sets by exact fieldKey; never issue one query per field
pmsFileArtifactField.dependency: reuse F-PLT-001 APIs, policy provider, short-lived access tickets, version facts and audit without changing F-PLT-001 state machines

templateMetadataPatch.rule: at least one patch field is present; absent and explicit null remain distinct where the field is nullable

revisionPatch.semantics: replace the complete DRAFT design payload after validation; never patch or publish a PUBLISHED revision

instancePatch.semantics: values is a partial JSON object; only present ordinary keys change and controlled file keys are rejected

permissions.fileActions: instance permission plus the matching F-PLT-001 function permission and DynamicForm FileBusinessObjectPolicyProvider approval
permissions.roleSeedPolicy: create menu and permission resources only; do not create or grant a new ordinary business role
permissions.frontendBackendTruth: allowedActions is a conservative server projection and every command revalidates after lock

transactions.setAvailability: CLAIM_IDEMPOTENCY; LOCK_TEMPLATE_AND_EXPECTED_VERSION; REQUIRE_CURRENT_PUBLISHED_FOR_ENABLE; CAS_AVAILABILITY; WRITE_SUCCESS_AUDIT_AND_IDEMPOTENCY; COMMIT

platformFacts.idempotencyPolicy: same key and canonical payload replays the completed response; different payload conflicts; Decision.IN_PROGRESS returns the existing stable business error with no second side effect
auditForbidden: complete rich text or form values
file body, storage key or permanent URL

seedRequirements: template and instance menus plus six stable permission resources
one enabled published example template using representative ordinary values and PmsFileArtifact
one disabled published example template excluded from selection
one draft-only template excluded from selection
creator marks and stable high-range or dedicated identifiers
forbidden: migrate or dual-write BPM or legacy PMS form data
modify legacy menu or role associations
invent WorkBinding, PRE-04, SCH, IMP, ACC or CUT business seed facts

acceptance.wholeLoop: configure -> preview -> publish -> enable -> manual select -> create frozen instance -> render -> fill ordinary and PmsFileArtifact fields -> save -> refresh
acceptance.legacyRegression: legacy BPM and pms_eng form and requirement-analysis routes, APIs and data remain unchanged
excludedClaims: SCH, IMP, ACC or CUT consumer completion
